symptoms_en: Caterpillars tunnel into leaves, stems and tubers (in the field and in storage), leaving galleries near the tuber eyes.
symptoms_hi: इल्लियाँ पत्तियों, तनों और कंदों (खेत और भंडारण दोनों में) में सुरंग बनाती हैं और कंद की आँखों के पास गैलरी छोड़ती हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of potato
symptoms_en.quote: It is a pest of field and storage Larva tunnels into foliage, stem and tubers Galleries are formed near tuber eyes

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of potato
management_en.quote: Select healthy tubers Avoid shallow planting of tubers. Plant the tubers to a depth at 10 - 15 cm deep

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of potato
management_en.quote: Adopt intercropping with chilies, onion or peas Do earthing up at 60 days after planting to avoid female moths laying eggs on the exposed tubers

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of potato
management_en.quote: Cover the upper surface of potato tubers with the branches of Lantana and Eupatorium to repel the ovipositing moth in the godown

management_en: Plant healthy tubers 10-15 cm deep and earth up at 60 days so moths cannot lay eggs on exposed tubers. Intercrop with chilli, onion or peas. Remove infested tubers and do not leave harvested tubers in the field overnight. Cover stored tubers with Lantana branches to repel moths.
management_hi: स्वस्थ कंद 10-15 सेमी गहरे लगाएँ और 60 दिन पर मिट्टी चढ़ाएँ ताकि पतंगे खुले कंदों पर अंडे न दें। मिर्च, प्याज़ या मटर के साथ अंतरफसल लें। संक्रमित कंद निकालें और खुदाई के बाद कंद रात भर खेत में न छोड़ें। भंडारण में कंदों को लैंटाना की टहनियों से ढकें।
